reviewedQuestion: Whether the supplied evidence supports a complete zero-product current food and nonalcoholic catalog or requires blocked_unverifiable because the complete current boundary is unavailable.

evidence.finding: The frozen zero-row manual-review baseline is not affirmative evidence that the operating restaurant has a zero-product catalog.
The official menu URL exposed no readable product list; retrieval absence cannot establish a zero-product catalog.
The officially linked Square surface exposed no readable menu and cannot prove completeness.
The linked DoorDash surface reports inactive status; cached product material was correctly rejected as current evidence.

resolution.rationale: No authoritative surface supplies a complete current food and nonalcoholic enumeration. Missing or unreadable menu evidence cannot support publication of an empty catalog.

coordinatorRecommendation: Record green-almond-pantry-dc as blocked_unverifiable and preserve accurately_unavailable allergen status without negative claims.
